title: Hyper Resource file
description: One Resource, as the file resources/<id>.json in a Space directory (ADR 0128). This schema composes the core's envelope with the built-in kinds' schemas, as a build registers them; the envelope's own rules name no kind, and content belongs to the kind and is validated by that kind's schema. Strict at both levels: the core refuses a top-level key it does not own, and the kind refuses a key inside content it does not declare.

content.description: The kind's own content, parsed only by the kind's module.

id.description: A durable UUID. A Resource's identity is this field, never its file name.

title.description: One or more Title Lines separated by newlines; the first is the Resource's name. At least one line must have something in it. Intake normalizes it: CR and CRLF fold to LF, trailing whitespace on each line and leading and trailing blank lines are dropped, interior blank lines are kept (ADR 0083).

kind.description: Required (ADR 0128). A built-in kind's bare id, or a vendor kind's vnd.<owner>.<name> (ADR 0120), whose owner and name are any non-empty text without a dot or whitespace until an ADR fixes their characters. A kind the build does not register is refused at intake; this schema cannot know which vendor kinds are registered, so it validates their content only as an object.
